access_notes: A 1978 essay in which PKD lays out a systematic cosmological model derived from his 2-3-74/3-74 experiences and the Exegesis. Full machine-readable text (474-line extraction). Posthumously collected (e.g. in 'The Shifting Realities of Philip K. Dick', 1995).
notes: PKD-authored metaphysical essay (lane B). The most systematic single statement of his 'two-source' cosmology; closely related to the Exegesis and to the essay 'How to Build a Universe' (same year). Shares the anamnesis / golden-fish material.
